title: neurocarpum guianense
intro: Neurocarpum guianense, commonly known as Guianan Pau' Branco, is a plant species native to the Guiana Shield in South America. It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Neurocarpum guianense include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in relieving pain and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
